claim_text: CHU de la Guadeloupe was hit by a cyberattack
summary: The hospital's director general says a cyberattack began Saturday evening, Nov 21, blocking IT and phones. Staff first thought it was an IT outage, then found encrypted databases, which he says proves a deliberate attack.
detail: All four outlets report the director's on-record statements, made in separate interviews and to AFP. He says the cause "is not accidental" and is "linked to an aggression". The hospital's national cybersecurity agency contact says the attack is serious (see c007).
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Separate outlets each report the hospital director stating on the record that the hospital is the victim of a cyberattack.
notes: Victim organization speaking on record to several outlets; the director is one source for the details.

claim_text: Databases were encrypted and are not accessible
summary: The director says some of the hospital's data was encrypted and is no longer accessible, and the hospital will restart software and databases one by one after checking no malware remains.
detail: La 1ère says a part of the databases was encrypted. France-Antilles quotes the director saying data was encrypted and medical files cannot be reached. Encryption does not by itself show ransomware; see c008.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Three outlets quote the director on encrypted, inaccessible data.

claim_text: Phones, imaging, labs and software are down; staff are using paper
summary: The hospital is back to paper and pencil, with couriers moving between departments. RCI lists phones, imaging, non-urgent lab work, printers and software as down at three sites, with the lab and radiology hit hardest.
detail: RFI says the attack touches all three sites with variable impacts. La 1ère says mainly the Chauvel site, with effects on Belle-Plaine. The director told France-Antilles Belle-Plaine's IT was not hit, with some phone damage. Lab results must be fetched on paper. The three-site list comes from RCI.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Three outlets report the hospital returning to manual procedures; RCI gives the list of down systems and sites.
notes: Site-by-site impact differs between outlets; the summary keeps the shared facts.

claim_text: Plan blanc on; non-urgent care cancelled through Nov 27
summary: The hospital triggered its plan blanc on Sunday, Nov 22. It is cancelling scheduled surgery, consultations and imaging through Fri, Nov 27, keeping urgent care, and asks patients to call the emergency dispatch line first.
detail: La 1ère gives the Nov 27 date and says the cancellations are partial. France-Antilles quotes the director on cancelling the coming week's activity and setting up a call centre for patients and families. RFI and RCI say non-urgent activity is cancelled for the week.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Four outlets report the plan blanc and cancellations; La 1ère gives the Nov 27 date.

claim_text: It first looked like an IT failure
summary: The director says it first looked like an IT outage on Saturday evening. Lost access to data and applications, then encrypted databases, showed the cause was deliberate.
detail: The France-Antilles interview quotes him saying the origin "is absolutely not accidental". RFI relays AFP quoting him on the encrypted databases.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Two outlets quote the director on the first impression and the finding.

claim_text: Attackers got in through a hacked IT supplier
summary: The director says an IT supplier of the hospital appears to have been attacked first, and the attackers then got into the hospital's system. RFI quotes a hedged account that the supplier was hacked months ago.
detail: The director uses hedged wording ("a priori", "it would seem"). La 1ère says attackers used the supplier's addresses to attack the hospital. RFI says the national cybersecurity agency has identified where it could come from. The supplier is not named in any story we read. This is a preliminary finding.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Three outlets relay the director’s hedged account of a supplier compromise.
notes: One source, the director. Preliminary and hedged.

claim_text: The national cybersecurity agency is helping and calls it serious
summary: The director says the national cybersecurity agency is helping, has told the hospital to expect a long recovery and, per RFI, confirmed the attack's seriousness. RCI says a meeting with the agency took place Sunday morning.
detail: RCI quotes the director saying the first exchanges with the agency were not encouraging: a serious attack, no restart of software or databases in the next two or three days, a gradual restart possible from the end of the week.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Three outlets report the director saying the agency is involved; RCI reports the meeting.

claim_text: Ransomware, a ransom demand, or a named group
summary: No outlet reports a ransom note or demand, a data leak or a group claiming the attack. The director has not said whether this is ransomware.
detail: Encryption is confirmed, which is common to ransomware, but no source says a demand was made. We did not look at leak sites, underground forums or trackers.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: None of the four sources mentions a ransom demand or an attacker claim.

claim_text: Whether patient data was stolen or could be published
summary: Asked whether medical data could be released, the director said that is part of the investigation and he cannot answer yet.
detail: No source reports data theft or a leak.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The France-Antilles interview records the director declining to answer.

claim_text: Pediatric emergency move to the new Belle-Plaine site is still on
summary: The hospital says the planned move of pediatric emergencies to the new Belle-Plaine building goes ahead overnight Nov 23 to 24. The director says the attack may slow later transfers.
detail: RFI and La 1ère give the night of Nov 23 to 24 (La 1ère: 12:01 AM). The director says teams tied up with the attack may be less available to prepare later transfers.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Three outlets relay the hospital plan; this is a plan, not an event yet.
notes: Planned event; not a fact until it happens.
